text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing and controlling threats to a project or business. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding out what could go wrong, such as financial loss, accidents or technical problems. After that, you need mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you can train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you know what to do if a problem actually happens. Finally, monitoring is essential. You should review risks regularly and update your plans when things change. Good risk management helps organisations avoid surprises and stay successful.
